_comment: Agent dev server, deliberately NOT the one you run on 5173.
Isolated so automation cannot recall states, assign LFOs or edit
params in a live session someone is working in — driving 5173 would
do exactly that. Its own port also means its own origin, so it cannot
touch your saved presets or slot contents (both per-origin).
Preferred over vite preview for iterating: no rebuild step, and no
hashed dist to serve a stale bundle from cache. Verify against
BROWSER=none stops Vite's server.open from popping a window.
configurations.name: imweb-dev-agent
